name: Darke County, OH
findings: Darke County has 213 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Darke County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 12 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
